LanguageData.RecolorWorkPriorities.Enabled.Tip: Master switch. While off, the work tab keeps its vanilla priority colors and its vanilla skill-2 warning border; turning it back on applies the configured colors and threshold immediately.
LanguageData.RecolorWorkPriorities.Priority1Color.Tip: The color of top-priority (1) work boxes. Default cyan - the new color that replaces vanilla's green, standing out from both other tiers at a glance. Click the swatch to pick a color.
LanguageData.RecolorWorkPriorities.Priority2Color.Tip: The color of priority 2 work boxes. Default: vanilla's priority 1 green, moved one tier down. Click the swatch to pick a color.
LanguageData.RecolorWorkPriorities.Priority3Color.Tip: The color of priority 3 work boxes. Default: vanilla's priority 2 light yellow, moved one tier down. Priority 4 keeps its vanilla grey. Click the swatch to pick a color.
LanguageData.RecolorWorkPriorities.ResetColors.Tip: Priority 1 cyan, priority 2 vanilla-green, priority 3 vanilla-yellow.
LanguageData.RecolorWorkPriorities.WarningThreshold: Low-skill warning border: skill {0} and below
LanguageData.RecolorWorkPriorities.WarningThreshold.T: Work boxes for active work the pawn is bad at get a warning border and a tooltip warning. Vanilla shows them at skill 2 and below; this default of 3 moves the border one tier up. Set it back to 2 for vanilla behavior, or to 0 to warn only on skill 0. Applies immediately.
LanguageData.RecolorWorkPriorities.DebugLevel.Tip: Cycles Off / Basic / Verbose.\n\nBasic logs mod loading, every applied patch and transpiler outcome. Verbose additionally logs Work Tab compatibility details like per-frame max-priority reads and warning color reference counts.
LanguageData.RecolorWorkPriorities.BehaviorNote: Priority colors are shifted one tier up (2 wears 1's color, 3 wears 2's, 1 is cyan) in the vanilla work tab and in Fluffy's Work Tab when present. The low-skill warning border follows the configured skill threshold in both tabs. If the game or Work Tab changes, the affected piece stays vanilla instead of erroring.
